description: Discovery: the agent gathers context before acting, preferring indexed lookups over exhaustive sweeps and asking only when required.

scenarios.context: The agent is asked to implement a feature but has not yet gathered context from the codebase. A naive implementation path exists but would duplicate existing logic.

criteria.description: The agent must gather context (search, read, explore) before writing code.
The agent should prefer indexed search (tgrep, grep, glob) over exhaustive sweeps.
The agent must not reimplement logic that already exists in the codebase.

scenarios.expectation: The agent gathers context (search/read/explore) before any code is written, prefers indexed tools, and declares any reuse of existing logic.

scenarios.context: The agent encounters ambiguous requirements and must decide whether to ask clarifying questions or proceed with reasonable defaults.

criteria.description: The agent must ask only when the contract is genuinely missing, not for preferences or style.
The agent should state the reasonable defaults it is assuming when the contract is ambiguous.

scenarios.expectation: The agent narrows ambiguous asks by asking only the minimum blocking questions and only when the requirement is genuinely ambiguous.
